context.content: I feel like there might be some features in my blogging engine I don’t use as well. And I also don’t remember them. 😅

replies.content: I think the frequency of big changes to my website decreased the last years. I’m running GoBlog for more than two years already and when adding or refactoring things, I regularly find code I haven’t touched in a long time. But because some other people use GoBlog as well, I try not to break things and make features opt-in. So if I don’t want to use them anymore, I can just disable them. 😄 And before implementing something new, I try (that isn’t always working though) to think twice whether I really need it.
